focus_areas: Structural integrity of the railing connections (baluster-to-rail).
Anatomical validity of the dark object perched on the handrail (bird/animal hallucination).
Impact of high-contrast binarization on geometric perception and text legibility.
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the object sitting on the handrail. Use the animal_pose_auditor results to definitively state if it has valid keypoints or if it is a melted shape. Also, evaluate if the extreme black-and-white contrast hides subtle fusion artifacts between the balusters and the background, and check the background for gibberish text artifacts.
image_description: A high-contrast, black-and-white image depicting a metal bannister running diagonally along a staircase. The railing features a top handrail and vertical balusters. Perched on the upper section of the handrail is a dark, indistinct figure that resembles a bird or small animal but lacks clear anatomical definition. The background shows architectural structures with heavy posterization effects.
